answer: A claim is proven by a voyage beyond its own island. A plume warden draws one job from a domain unrelated to the claim and the claimant has one hour to finish it live while an auditor checks each step against the sealed reference. A copied step, a wrong result, or silence is a stranded voyage: claim void, fee burned, barred a week. Five cents and a strange job buy an honest pass; 1,000 fakes pay $50 and need 1,000 workers fluent in every domain.
